description.narrative: Stöd syftar till att stärka/förbättra kvaliteten och relevansen i Tanzanias nationella forskningskapacitet för att bidra till minskad fattigdom och hållbar utveckling. Mål: att förbättra forsknings-kapacitet och dess tillämpning vid ARU i områden naturresurs förvaltning, urbanism, forskningsförvaltning.

Support aims to strengthen/improve quality and relevance of the Tanzania national research capacity to contribute to poverty reduction and sustainable development. Objective: enhance research capacity and its application at ARU in areas of natural resources management, urbanism, research management.

Övergripande fråga: Resultat kopplat till avsedd effekt 2014Fråga: Sammanfatta resultat relaterade till avsedd effekt (denna information kommer att skickas till Open Aid).Svar: The main objective is to strengthen research capacity at Ardhi University and disseminate research outputs in land, housing and environment in relation to the problems faced by local communities in Tanzania by strenghtening the institutional research capacity At Ardhi Unviersity through PhD and MSc trainingof their staff in areas of research relevant for poverty redcition in Tanzania. It also aims at incresing the otuput of relveant research through funding of competitive research. The target is to train a total of 6 PhD and 6 MSc students amogn staff. Further 10 research projects will be supported. 6 PhD candidates have completed their Licentiate degree at KTH. One has previously obtained a PHD degree. During the reporting year 4 PhD candidates has graduated, leaving one to graduate after the agreement period has ended. 4 MSc students have completed their studies and 2 will graduate after the agreement period has ended. In previous years12 resarch projects have been implemented and resulted in 10 reports and 2 journal publications. This year focused on developing further publications: manuscripts for 21 book chapters were developed as well as five papers for submission to scientific journals.
